Command researchBack to WQV Link

The unknown commands may change watch data or settings. Their effects are not established. Each step sends one command with no parameters; this is not a firmware reader.

Steps

    AA is a control request. AD exists in Casio Link 3. The remaining codes are guesses from gaps or neighboring numbers.

    1. Prepare USB first

    Disconnect this adapter in other apps. Prepare USB before enabling transfer mode on the watch. No watch command is sent during preparation.

    2. Reset the watch, then run this step

    Exit the previous transfer session on the watch. Select IR → PC → F / REMOTE again and face the watch toward the adapter. No factory reset is needed.

    One application command, no automatic retransmission. Normal IrDA discovery, negotiation and acknowledgements are still sent. The page stops after the response window and releases USB; it does not advance to another command.

    Opening the local journal…

    Raw results

    Every USB read and write is saved locally, including empty reads, errors and bytes rejected by CRC. ZIPs contain the original binary streams, timestamps, transfer boundaries, decoded frames and the complete application response. Nothing is uploaded.
